name: The Ultimate Wedding Dress Bag - Ivory
description: On your wedding day, the last thing you want to do is search for a missing element of your look. In addition to a roomy main compartment for your wedding gown, this nine-pocket garment bag nixes any wardrobe confusion by providing dedicated space for every last accessory, including shoes, veil, headpiece and more. Crafted of transparent, lace-printed PEVA to make completing a visual scan of your ensemble fast and easy, this durable garment bag also features a reinforced hanger hole and an ID tag pocket. By SetReady Features nine pockets for accessories and shoes, internal veil slot, reinforced hanger hole, and ID tag pocket PEVA, nylon, polyester 72"H, 24"W, 12"D Imported
